target: forge.sh pr-state — local, empty, non-https, unparseable URLs and a missing credential print UNKNOWN, exit 0 and make no request (control: a valid call reaches the transport)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
P="/api/v4/projects/grp%2Fsub%2Fproj/merge_requests/7"
U=https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7
fx_http "GET $P" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
t() { fx_run pr-state "$2"; echo "$1=$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"; }
t local local
t empty ""
t http http://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7
t garbage "not a url at all"
t bare https://gitlab.example.test/
t notmr https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj/issues/7
unset FORGE_TOKEN; t notoken "$U"
echo "reqs_before_control=$(fx_nreq)"
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001; t control "$U"
echo "reqs_after=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_done
